# oncallalert_user_override (Resource)

A temporary override on a schedule: add a user, remove a user, or replace one with another. Set `add_user_id`, `remove_user_id`, or both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Bob covers for Alice over the holidays.
resource "oncallalert_user_override" "holiday" {
  schedule_id    = oncallalert_schedule.backend.id
  start          = "2026-12-24T00:00:00Z"
  end            = "2026-12-27T00:00:00Z"
  add_user_id    = data.oncallalert_user.bob.id
  remove_user_id = data.oncallalert_user.alice.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end` (String) Override end (RFC3339).
- `schedule_id` (String)
- `start` (String) Override start (RFC3339).

### Optional

- `add_user_id` (String) User to put on call.
- `remove_user_id` (String) User to take off call.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import oncallalert_user_override.example <id>
```
